designs.name: Walnut Atelier
designs.summary: Walnut Parsons storage bed, black reeded bedsides, amber-glass lamps and taupe textiles.
reviewNotes: 7 current images reviewed as human-view illustrations; three matched day/night cameras plus one golden-hour study.
Three human viewpoints: open entrance doorway, bedroom side of bathroom doorway, and beside the concealed old window-type AC looking toward the TV and doors.

The 1600 mm eye-height camera guides retain solid walls and use the real entrance opening. Adjacent hallway standing clearance is unsurveyed. AI images are illustrative and do not certify camera coordinates, dimensions, installation fit or human design approval.

D3 is diffuse daylight with electric lights off. N1 uses closed blackout curtains, 2700 K bedside lamps, 3000 K downward valance lighting and existing ceiling-panel ambient light. Fixtures outside the crop are not drawn; total fixture count, positions, CCT and lumens remain unmeasured. D4 is an illustrative golden-hour view from the old window-AC side.
Supplier photographs govern the purchase. Wilke artwork unavailable; bedside finish conflict and made-to-order lead time unresolved.
Review checks visible product identity, materials and lighting only. No human design approval or construction-fit certification is implied.

Exact finished sleeping pad 1828.8 × 1981.2 × 50 mm on a continuous flat deck. Bed opening, deck height/support, foam grade and custom fabrication remain supplier-measured conditions; a nominal 2-inch mattress is not exact 50 mm.

Existing short honey parquet and ivory walls retained. Mirror on the perpendicular return between the doors; 75-inch TV on the footwall and split AC at its high window-side corner. Door swings and all seated TV sightlines require physical validation.

Davies Beige opaque curtains conceal the old window AC, separate white voile and slim valance. Full installed scope, hardware, controls, exact fabric and blackout performance require written confirmation.
Each alternative includes two sleeping pillows and two blank owner-photo frames. Common equipment and allowances are included once per alternative, not added across P/Q/R.

The omitted plant and P planter allowance retain their product IDs and supplier references as history. The published plant-removal budget excludes floor plants and planters; its figures are preserved without further recalculation.

designs.name: Plum Lacquer
designs.summary: Charcoal button-tufted wingback Griffin II on a walnut drawer base, dressed in a quiet grey quilt cover with a plum-and-lilac handwoven Pintig cushion and a 1.8 m dark-red eucalyptus branch in a smoked-grey glass floor vase. Dark case goods: black-brown KULLEN two-drawer bedsides and a black Sigma Senor console. Smoked glass is the light: HÖGVIND grey-glass table lamps. A dark-grey Kelly swivel tub chair, a black wavy Sabrina floor mirror, a dark RÅVAROR stripe flatweave with fine wine-red lines and one large black-and-grey abstract canvas over the bed. Squint phrase: dark lacquer, plum, smoked glass.

designs.author: Fable / Claude
designs.name: Wengue Teal
designs.summary: The dark wengue Fino bed with its black floating headboard carries the room; everything else is pale so it reads. Teal is the one colour: a teal sunburst cushion on an ivory bamboo duvet, a faceted teal glass vase on the console and the blue-teal abstract over the bed. White MALM drawers, a white-gloss BYÅS console and a cream ISMANTORP armchair with bentwood-style arms keep the floor light; satin-nickel Larcy lamps and a chrome-framed mirror give the cool metal. Ivory GEOLOG rug, grey bamboo sheets and a pencil succulent in a white bowl. Squint phrase: dark bed, ivory, teal.

designs.author: Fable / Claude
designs.name: Birch Coral
designs.summary: Pale birch and oak throughout: the spindle-headboard BJÖRKSNÄS bed, Astrid two-drawer bedsides, an Amanda light-oak console and a maple-framed Jea mirror. Coral is the one accent, in a terracotta linen lumbar cushion and the coral half-circle prints over the bed, with the pink JÄRNVÄG rug as its quiet echo. Off-white BLIDVÄDER stoneware lamps, a natural faux-linen comforter, sand sheets and an oak HAY Arbour chair in rose. An olive stem in a whitewashed terracotta vase. Squint phrase: pale birch, coral, ceramic.

designs.author: Claude Fable
designs.name: Black Marble Archive
designs.summary: Black Marble Archive. A short corridor between two dark-painted arches, honey-amber parquet underfoot, the curtained window run on one side and the plain off-white wall on the other. On the plain wall the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203, a 104 x 65 cm mosaic of small LEGO studs in deep blue oceans with tan and white continents, hangs at true scale with its bottom edge 1.1 m from the floor, centred over an Ashley Fargenta six-drawer dresser in black lacquer with a white replicated-marble top and slim brass bar pulls, standing on short black legs. On the dresser top, at the dining end, an At Home Gwen table lamp in gold with a white drum shade; at the living end a few framed family photographs and one small keepsake. A slim warm LED halo frame sits behind the map, switched off in daylight so it reads only as a thin shadow line around the mosaic. On the parquet in front of the dresser an IKEA STRÖG flatwoven natural jute rug, 120 x 180, its long side along the corridor, parquet showing on every side. The plain wall between the dresser and the dining arch stays empty, so the map is the single exhibit in the corridor. Davies Beige blackout and voile curtains with a valance board run the full length of the window side; daylight from the window, no ceiling light on. Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: the corridor 2300 x 4400, ceiling 2700, both arches, the 3590 window run (Seoul Blinds quote O04) with sill 900 and head 2350, and the light switch are assumed values with a stated basis, none taped. The LEGO Art World Map 31203 hangs at its product size, 1040 x 650, bottom 1100. Nothing taped, nothing bought.
reviewNotes: Render QA (a reviewer per design against the 3:2 model views and the product photos, then an independent verifier, 23 Oct): the three-quarter view passes. In the other three the dresser comes out too deep (from the living and from the dining, about 20 to 25%) or too low (straight on, about 8%), and the view from the living adds a dark timber strip at its left edge; two fix passes did not correct them, so the truest render of each is shown. Minor: the lamp reads about 1.3 to 1.5 times its size. LEGO scale check: both map-wall views pass (straight on: map aspect +3.2%, map to dresser +0.2%; three-quarter: map to dresser +4.98%).

Ashley Fargenta 1499 x 406 x 889: top at 889, so the map's bottom edge at 1100 leaves a 211 mm reveal; the map (1040) is centred on the dresser (1499) with 230 mm of top free at each end for the lamp and the photos.

Passage: 2300 (assumed) less 406 leaves about 1.9 m beside the dresser. The map is centred at 2200 from the living end (edges 1680 to 2720); if the light switch proves to sit more than 1.6 m along the wall, slide the whole composition 200 mm toward the dining arch.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).

designs.name: Harbour Grey
designs.summary: Harbour Grey. A short corridor between two open round-headed archways with thick dark-stained timber casings, honey-amber parquet underfoot, the curtained window run on one side and the plain off-white wall on the other. Both archways are open passages with no door, panel or curtain in them: through the living arch the living room shows beyond and through the dining arch the dining room, white walls and the same parquet running on into each, so the corridor clearly opens into a room at each end. On the plain wall the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203, a 104 x 65 cm mosaic of small LEGO studs in deep blue oceans with tan and white continents, hangs at true scale with its bottom edge 1.1 m from the floor, centred over a BoConcept Lugano double dresser in light warm-grey lacquer: six wide handleless drawers whose fronts are carved with fine horizontal grooves, on slim dark steel legs, 154 cm long and 93 cm high, so a 17 cm strip of wall shows between its top and the map. Mounted on the wall about 12 cm above the map's top edge and centred on it, an IKEA FLASKPOST slim chrome LED bar light, 82 cm long, angled down at the mosaic like a picture light (off in daylight). On the dresser top at the dining end an Ashley Lemmitt table lamp, a round navy-blue art-glass base with a white drum shade; at the living end two or three photographs in thin silver and black frames and a small white ceramic dish. On the parquet in front of the dresser an IKEA KONSTRUNDA rug, 80 x 160 cm, bold black-and-white bars with notched ends, its long side along the corridor, parquet showing on every side. In the window-side corner at the dining end, beside the arch pier, an Ashley faux eucalyptus-style tree about 1.5 m tall, small grey-green leaves on a slender trunk in a black pot. Toward the living end, about 12 cm beyond the dresser's end, a small white light switch plate at about 1.4 m stays visible and uncovered. Davies Beige blackout and voile curtains with a valance board run the full length of the window side, the voile drawn and the blackout stacked open; daylight from the window, no ceiling light on. Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured. The LED bar light is a proposal: hallway lighting is undecided.
reviewNotes: Design author: Claude Opus (Opus 5.5). The AI style renders come from Codex image generation; do not conflate tool with design author. No human approval inferred.

LEGO scale gate (Ivan, 23 Oct): the elevation and quarter renders are measured against the true-scale projection of the 1040 x 650 map and the catalogue dresser (±5%), the dresser ends read by eye on 1:1 crops of each render; a failing view is regenerated up to 3 times, and one that still fails is not published. 1 view(s) of this design withheld; they show the true-scale model view. Measurements: scale/ in the pack.
Arches open (Ivan, 23 Oct: "i need to see opening to the other rooms"): both arches are open passages with dark-stained timber casings, and the map-wall view stands back far enough to show both.

Night views (Ivan, 23 Oct: valance-LED rule, no added ceiling light): blackout curtains closed, lit only by the valance LED, the existing downlight and the table lamp, with the proposed lights off; the elevation and quarter night renders go through the same LEGO scale gate. Both gated night views pass. Measurements: scale-night/ in the pack.

Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: every dimension is assumed with a stated basis, none taped (ceiling 2700; corridor 2300 x 4400, the length from the F035 camera fit and the quoted 3590 window run; the window run from 500 off the dining end, sill 900, head 2350; the light switch back-projected to about 1.95 m from the living end at about 1.42 m, where the Fable hallway file has 0.5 to 1.7 m). Tape the switch before drilling.

Layout: the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203 at true scale (1040 x 650), bottom 1100, centred 2870 from the living end so it clears the switch; a solid dresser with more drawers centred below it (Ivan, 23 Oct); parquet kept with a rug; dark-stained arch casings kept; Davies Beige blackout and voile with valances; no hallway aircon.
Proposals, not decisions: hallway lighting is undecided (Ivan, 23 Oct), so the wall lights in this design are proposals; the renders show the lights switched off.

BoConcept Lugano 1540 x 480 x 930: the tallest top of the three, so the map's bottom edge at 1100 leaves a 170 mm reveal (photos up to 13 x 18 cm stand under it); raise the map 80 mm to 1180 if a 250 mm reveal matters more than the 1.1 m line.

The map (1040) is centred on the dresser (1540) with 250 mm of top free at each end; the chrome bar hangs about 120 mm above the map's top edge; the light switch stays about 120 mm beyond the dresser's living end.

designs.name: Charcoal Gallery
designs.summary: Charcoal Gallery. A short corridor between two open round-headed archways with thick dark-stained timber casings, honey-amber parquet underfoot, the curtained window run on one side and the plain wall on the other; this one wall is painted a deep warm charcoal from the skirting to the cornice, while the other walls and the ceiling stay off-white. Both archways are open passages with no door, panel or curtain in them: through the living arch the living room shows beyond and through the dining arch the dining room, white walls and the same parquet running on into each, so the corridor clearly opens into a room at each end. On the charcoal wall the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203, a 104 x 65 cm mosaic of small LEGO studs in deep blue oceans with tan and white continents, hangs at true scale with its bottom edge 1.1 m from the floor, centred over a BLIMS Freya dresser in dark espresso wood: eight drawers in two columns, the upper six with flat fronts and slim dark pulls, the bottom two with vertical reeded fronts, on a low recessed plinth, 150 cm long and 82.5 cm high, its top 27 cm below the map. Above the map's two top corners a pair of IKEA SKURUP black wall spotlights, small dome shades on short arms, aimed down at the mosaic like gallery lights (off in daylight), their cords hidden in charcoal cord channels. On the dresser top at the dining end a Mejore Taron table lamp, a dark amber-to-smoke glass cube base with brass fittings under a rectangular natural linen shade; at the living end photographs in thin black frames. On the parquet in front of the dresser an IKEA VAGNAT flatwoven rug, 133 x 195 cm, off-white with a grey diamond lattice and small ochre accents, its long side along the corridor, parquet showing on every side. At the living end of the charcoal wall an IKEA HOVET mirror, 78 x 196 cm in a thin black frame, leans against the wall and reflects the beige curtains. Between the mirror and the dresser a small white light switch plate at about 1.4 m stays visible and uncovered. No plant. Davies Beige blackout and voile curtains with a valance board run the full length of the window side, the voile drawn and the blackout stacked open; daylight from the window, no ceiling light on. Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured. The charcoal paint and the two spotlights are proposals: hallway lighting is undecided.

designs.author: Claude Opus
designs.name: Midnight Velvet
designs.summary: Midnight Velvet. Squint and the room is deep navy velvet and smoked dark oak on cream, quiet and evening-rich. The BoConcept axo table, 1600 x 850, has a smoked dark-brown oak top, plain and rectangular, on two pairs of flat slab legs set in from the ends, as in the product photo; it stands in the corner between the four-light south window and the plain east wall, its long side parallel to the window and its east end a hand's width (10 cm) from the east wall under the split unit, so the counter side of the room stays open as a clear walkway from the kitchen and the bedroom passage to the arch. The tabletop is bare: no vase, bowl, runner, fruit or plant on it. Five Our Home Hilaire chairs, rounded tub seats in deep navy-blue velvet with a back of wide woven velvet straps, on slim black tapered legs, as in the product photo: two on the window side, two on the room side and one at the west end; the east end against the wall has no chair. Under them a Crate & Barrel Fez hand-tufted rug, 8 x 10 ft, a cream ground drawn with fine thin sand-brown lines in a large open diamond lattice with a few small dots, laid long side to the window and pushed up to the east wall, with every chair leg on it and its far edge short of the curtains. In the opposite corner, against the north wall right beside the arch and at the far end from the kitchen pass-through, a Furniture Manila StackLine open shelf, 64 wide, 34 deep and 94 high: a black square-post frame with ladder-rung sides and three grey-brown oak-look shelves, open with no doors and nothing on it, as in the product photo. On the plain west wall at the table's west end hangs one Ashley framed abstract, 71 x 99 portrait, a soft beige ground with a navy-blue curved shape, a pale blue block and a small olive circle, in a thin black frame. In the south-west corner by the window a Flourish faux split-leaf philodendron, large glossy dark-green split leaves in a black pot. Walls stay the existing cream, floor the honey-amber parquet, a plain flat white ceiling with no ceiling fan, pendant or hanging light of any kind, Davies Beige blackout and voile on the four-light south window, the room's only window, and a white split unit sits high on the east wall over the table.

Drawn: the stepped outline of the dimension contract (3831 across the arch end, 3680 across the window end, 4468 deep), the pass-through 1071, the south window 3558 in four lights; the west wall has no window (Ivan, 23 Oct). designs.author: Claude Opus
designs.name: Heritage Persian
designs.summary: Heritage Persian. Squint and the room is a black stone oval, dark turned wood with cane, and a soft grey Persian rug on cream walls, warmed by an ochre print. The Mejore Benson oval table, 140 x 90, has a polished black marble-look stone top with faint white veining on a black reeded, vertically fluted X-shaped pedestal base, as in the product photo; it stands in the corner between the four-light south window and the plain east wall, its long axis parallel to the window and its east end 20 cm from the east wall under the split unit, so the counter side of the room stays open as a clear walkway from the kitchen and the bedroom passage to the arch. The tabletop is bare: no vase, bowl, runner, fruit or plant on it. Five Mejore Philip side chairs, dark reddish-brown wood frames with turned front legs and stretchers, a natural cane-webbing back panel and a pale grey upholstered seat, as in the product photo: two on the window side, two on the room side and one at the west end; the east end against the wall has no chair. Under them a Crate & Barrel Avalon hand-knotted wool rug, 8 x 10 ft, a traditional Persian all-over floral pattern in soft grey and taupe on cream with a wide patterned border, as in the product photo, laid long side to the window and pushed up to the east wall, with every chair leg on it and its far edge short of the curtains. In the opposite corner, against the north wall right beside the arch and at the far end from the kitchen pass-through, a Furniture Manila TierCraft ladder shelf, 67 wide, 33 deep and 160 high, leaning against the wall: five dark walnut-look tray shelves with low raised rims on two dark brown-black A-frame rails, open with no doors and nothing on it, as in the product photo. On the plain west wall at the table's west end hangs one Ashley framed print, 120 x 80, soft ochre, sand and caramel dune shapes on cream in a thin frame. In the south-west corner by the window an Ashley faux leafy tree, 183 high, small green leaves on slim stems in a black pot. Walls stay the existing cream, floor the honey-amber parquet, a plain flat white ceiling with no ceiling fan, pendant or hanging light of any kind, Davies Beige blackout and voile on the four-light south window, the room's only window, and a white split unit sits high on the east wall over the table.
